{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ExternalMetadataMessagePackObject_GeneratedFormatterHasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = frameworkReferences\n            .Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack))\n            .ToImmutableArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        string externalSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace ExternalAssembly\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class ExternalData\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Id { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public string Name { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation externalCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ExternalAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(externalSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream externalAssemblyStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = externalCompilation.Emit(externalAssemblyStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference externalAssemblyReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(externalAssemblyStream.ToArray());\n\n        string localSource = \"\"\"\n            using ExternalAssembly;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace LocalAssembly\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class LocalContainer\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public ExternalData Data { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation localCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"LocalAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(localSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences.Add(externalAssemblyReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(localCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Single(runResult.Results);\n        Assert.Null(runResult.Results[0].Exception);\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol externalDataSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"ExternalAssembly.ExternalData\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(externalDataSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(externalDataSymbol.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        INamedTypeSymbol constructedFormatterInterface = formatterInterface.Construct(externalDataSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterType = Assert.Single(\n            GetAllTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace)\n                .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(constructedFormatterInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default)));\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            formatterType.GetAttributes(),\n            attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n\n        SyntaxTree formatterSyntaxTree = Assert.Single(formatterType.DeclaringSyntaxReferences).SyntaxTree;\n        GeneratedSourceResult generatedFormatterSource = Assert.Single(\n            runResult.Results[0].GeneratedSources.Where(s => s.SyntaxTree == formatterSyntaxTree));\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            \"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\",\n            generatedFormatterSource.SourceText.ToString(),\n            StringComparison.Ordinal);\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol deeper in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return deeper;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
